independentControlOrdering: Independent control records appended after ongoing polling; sequence is capture insertion order, absolute timestamps define chronological ordering.

bounds.scope: One empty PAY_PER_REQUEST source with two GSIs, same account, us-east-1/us-east-2, MREC ordinary UpdateTable. No load, provisioned autoscaling, SSE, MRSC, cross-account or legacy claims.
bounds.timestamps: startedAt/finishedAt are absolute UTC; startedOffsetSeconds restarts per fresh subprocess phase.
bounds.rejectionObservation: Both regional public DescribeTable states observed before and after each request. Unchanged means selected stable public membership/settings only, not proof about invisible internal side effects or unbounded eventual behavior.
bounds.classDefaultNormalization: Missing TableClassSummary normalized to STANDARD. Missing StreamSpecification normalized to StreamEnabled:false.
bounds.cleanup: PAY_PER_REQUEST requested no scalable resources; nevertheless inspect and remove any owned policies, targets and managed alarms, then verify absence.

scopeLimitations: One empty MREC table with two Regions and two GSIs; not MRSC, legacy global tables or multi-account replication.
Initial bounded observations remained UPDATING; the later ACTIVE-state followup establishes settlement without an exact transition duration.
Post-delete standalone StreamEnabled:false, missing-peer Update, and standalone zero-limit controls were not exercised.

findings.claim: Replica Create plus source table/GSI on-demand limits, table class, deletion protection, stream enable or structural GSI Create receives ValidationException: Replica modification must be the only operation in the request. Both regional membership/settings snapshots remain unchanged.

Combined Replica Update and Delete exclusions leave source/peer settings unchanged both during the initial UPDATING interval and in the later ACTIVE-state followup. Standalone replica-only Delete succeeds after settlement.
Only-operation validation precedes missing source lookup. Replica Create without source settings on the same missing name reaches ResourceNotFoundException.

Nonempty AttributeDefinitions with Replica Create reaches missing-source ResourceNotFoundException; empty GlobalSecondaryIndexUpdates with Replica Create receives the independent List of GlobalSecondaryIndexUpdates is empty ValidationException. Attributes-only and empty-GSI-only requests instead receive the At least one...required ValidationException.

Empty AttributeDefinitions with replica table/GSI overrides is accepted; requested read caps become visible before table settlement. After an initially exhausted observation bound, both regional tables and their indexes were observed ACTIVE.

Owned scaling targets, policies and managed alarms were verified absent in both regions. After AWS released the pending transition, peer-first replica deletion and then source deletion succeeded; both regional tables are verified absent.

followups.purpose: settled exclusion controls and peer-first cleanup

acceptedUpdateSettlement.observedResult: Both regional tables remained UPDATING through the initial 5021-second bound despite visible requested read caps. Followup sequences834-835 observed both tables and all indexes ACTIVE; the exact transition time between these observations is unknown.
